title: Cargo Door Latching Station Position Sensor — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of one latch position sensor and its bracket from a cargo door latching station, with the door held open on ground support and the latching mechanism made safe.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of one latch position sensor from a latching station of the forward, aft or bulk cargo door. Use it for sensor replacement or for access to the latching rib assembly behind it.
sections.job_setup_note: Open the door and put it on the ground support strut before you start. The latching mechanism must be in the unlatched position and pinned. Put the maintenance notice on the door control panel so that nobody operates the door while the sensor is out. One person can do the task but a second is needed at the door control panel.
sections.procedure: WARNING: PUT THE GROUND SUPPORT STRUT UNDER THE CARGO DOOR AND PIN THE LATCHING MECHANISM BEFORE YOU PUT YOUR HAND INSIDE THE LATCH SHROUD. THE DOOR CAN MOVE IF THE CONTROL PANEL IS OPERATED. Open the cargo door and install the ground support strut. Put the latching mechanism in the unlatched position and install the safety pins at each station. Put the maintenance notice on the door control panel. Remove the screws LN143422-1C from the cover plate at the station and take the cover plate off. Release the cable ties LN309661K1 that hold the sensor cable to the door harness. Disconnect the sensor connector and fit a protective cap. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE SENSOR CABLE HANG BY ITS CONNECTOR. SUPPORT IT AT THE FIRST CLAMP, BECAUSE THE TERMINATION IS EASILY STRAINED. Remove the sensor from the bracket plate CAL808635-46, keeping the shim pack together and identified. Remove the bracket plate if the latching rib assembly D5230135992491 behind it is to be worked. Put a protective cover over the open station.
sections.close_out: Put the sensor, the shim pack and the mounting hardware in a labelled container so that the same shim pack can be used at installation. Leave the safety pins and the maintenance notice in place until the installation task is complete. Record the removal in the aircraft technical log with the station identity.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. On aircraft with duplicated sensing, each station has two sensors and each is removed separately.

safety_precautions: Install the ground support strut under the cargo door.
Pin the latching mechanism at each station.
Put the maintenance notice on the door control panel.
